description: This file defines a template specialization for a warp-level GEMM operator using tensor operations, specifically for CUDA GPU architectures. It includes class templates and policies for performing matrix multiplication with various data types and layouts, utilizing the CUTLASS library.

classes.name: DefaultMmaTensorOp
classes.description: Template specialization for warp-level GEMM tensor operations with specific data types, layouts, and partitioning parameters.

methods.name: DefaultMmaTensorOp
methods.description: Defines the warp-level tensor operation policy and the specific tensor operation type for given shape, data types, and layouts.
